mapper.sql: select soi.stock_out_item_id, soi.stock_out_id, soi.input_id, ai.input_name, ai.sku as input_sku, soi.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, soi.batch_no, soi.quantity, soi.remarks from inv_stock_out_item soi left join agri_input ai on soi.input_id = ai.input_id and ai.del_flag = '0' left join inv_warehouse w on soi.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id and w.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert:
insert into inv_stock_out_item (stock_out_item_id, stock_out_id, input_id, warehouse_id, batch_no, quantity, remarks, create_people, create_time, del_flag) values
(#{item.stockOutItemId}, #{item.stockOutId}, #{item.inputId}, #{item.warehouseId}, #{item.batchNo}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.remarks}, #{item.createPeople}, #{item.createTime}, '0')
